title: PR #73: docs: establish canonical Aurora AI compute platform architecture
content:
State: open

## Purpose
Establish the canonical Aurora AI / ATC AI Compute Platform architecture and preserve Standalone First, Ecosystem Second.

## Boundaries
- Aurora is not the ShivaCore TCB or blockchain consensus authority.
- Aurora Runtime is distinct from ATC AI Runtime.
- CPU/GPU/NPU are explicit compute backends.
- NPU is not a trust domain by default.
- TPM, secure processor and TEE remain distinct.
- Hardware architecture is manufacturer- and product-neutral.
- No external platform AI runtime is a normative dependency.

## Evidence
This PR adds architecture/specification/governance documentation only. It does not claim implementation, testing, CI verification, integration or E2E verification.

No Evidence, No Trust.
